About Organization

The Uttar Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (UPSRTC) is a public sector undertaking that provides bus transport services in the state of Uttar Pradesh, India.

UPSRTC is responsible for providing efficient and affordable bus transport services to the people of Uttar Pradesh.

About the Programme

The UPSRTC Bus Conductor Recruitment 2026 is a government job opportunity for candidates who want to work as bus conductors in various districts of Uttar Pradesh.

The programme aims to recruit eligible candidates for the post of bus conductor and provide them with a chance to work with the UPSRTC.
